name: Zovo Invoice MCP
description: Creates numbered line-item invoices with multi-rate VAT, renders them as downloadable documents, and tracks clients and payments over MCP, for freelancers and small businesses.

skills.name: Invoice Creation
skills.description: Creates numbered line-item invoices with invoice_create, or builds them from tracked hours with invoice_from_hours, applying VAT rates in integer minor units.

skills.name: Client Records
skills.description: Adds, lists, and removes clients with client_add, client_list, and client_delete, and stores the issuing business profile, currency, and default VAT rate via business_set.

skills.name: Invoice Documents
skills.description: Renders an invoice to a downloadable document via invoice_pdf, returning a time-limited URL carrying the invoice number, client, VAT line, and total.

skills.name: Payment Tracking
skills.description: Marks invoices paid with invoice_mark_paid, retrieves them with invoice_list and invoice_get, and reports what is still outstanding with overdue_report.
